deed: רות הנדלר והשד התותב לנשים אחרי סרטן
title: Ruth Handler, creator of Barbie, had breast cancer and developed a silicone prosthesis for women after mastectomy

trailer.text: Ruth Handler, who started the toy company Mattel with her husband, is known mainly as the creator of the Barbie doll.
In 1970, while she was chief executive officer of Mattel, Ruth Handler was diagnosed with breast cancer.
She experimented with plastic and silicone and worked with a prosthetics specialist to create a better solution for breast cancer survivors.
The result was Nearly Me, a breast form made of liquid silicone and plastic, in a wide range of sizes and in versions for the right side and the left side.
By 1980 her company, Ruthton, was celebrating millions of dollars in sales, and Nearly Me continues to make breast prostheses.

glance.label: The product
glance.value: Nearly Me, a liquid silicone breast prosthesis

paragraphs.text: In 1970, while she was serving as chief executive officer of Mattel, Handler was diagnosed with breast cancer.
She underwent a mastectomy, but the sources describe it in different ways.
One doctor advised her to stuff her bra with old nylon stockings, an idea that repulsed her.
At the time, the typical breast cancer survivor relied on cotton stuffing or padded bras.
There were very few non-surgical alternatives to breast reconstruction.
The artificial breasts were used interchangeably for the right or left side, so a natural look was almost impossible to achieve.
Handler said that the existing prostheses were designed by men who did not have to wear them.
According to Susan Shapiro, after the mastectomy Handler was extremely depressed and felt she had lost part of her identity.
In 1994 she told CBS that when she lost her breast she felt as if she had lost her femininity.

stations.title: A silicone breast, for right and left

paragraphs.text: Handler experimented with plastic and silicone and worked with a prosthetics specialist to create a better solution for breast cancer survivors.
The result was Nearly Me, a liquid silicone and plastic form that was available in a wide range of sizes.
According to Global News, Handler set out to create the world’s first liquid silicone breast form, meant to fit into a bra rather than under the skin.
The prosthesis cost between $98 and $130 and was available in versions for the left side and the right side.
In 1977 Handler told the New York Times that no shoemaker makes one shoe and forces you to put both your right and your left foot in it.
According to Biography.com, Handler founded Ruthton Corp. in 1976 and created Nearly Me, inspired by her own recovery process.
Through this company she manufactured a more realistic version of a woman's breast.
The company's slogan was that the best artificial breast is made by a woman.
Handler appeared at department stores and invited late-night hosts to touch the prosthetic breast as proof of its true-to-life feel.
She allowed journalists and other women to touch the prostheses and feel their lifelike texture.
According to the Jewish Women's Archive, she challenged reporters to touch her breasts and guess which one was real.
She appeared on talk shows and wrote handwritten invitations, and her sales team trained department store workers to fit prostheses.
She employed women who had undergone mastectomies to advise customers and fit them with the prosthesis.
She also fitted former first lady Betty Ford with a custom Nearly Me prosthesis.
Nearly Me arrived at a time when the feminist health movement was changing the discussion about women and cancer survivorship.
Within five years of its creation, sales passed a million US dollars.
By 1980 Ruthton was celebrating millions of dollars in sales.
According to Kveller, the company helped thousands of women.
Handler ran Ruthton until 1991 and then sold it to Kimberly-Clark.
Even after the sale she continued to educate women about the importance of screenings for early detection of breast cancer.
She said the business did not earn her much money, but it rebuilt her self-esteem, and in her view that of others too.
According to Kveller, she said she found it even more important to return self-esteem to women who had lost it.
Handler died in 2002, but Nearly Me continues to make breast prostheses.
According to SurvivorNet, the product line still exists today alongside similar products such as mastectomy bras.
A Global News writer, herself a breast cancer survivor who uses a prosthesis from another brand, says that in the right clothes her prosthesis is undetectable and the symmetry is precise.
Handler was born in Denver in 1916, and she is best known for creating Barbie.
Kveller describes her as the Jewish creator of Barbie.
She and her husband helped found Temple Isaiah synagogue in Los Angeles and gave to Jewish causes.
There are two versions of the year Mattel was founded.
Handler died in 2002.
The sources describe the cause of her death differently.
Handler left Mattel amid investigations into the company's financial reports.
According to History.com, the Securities and Exchange Commission investigated her and other executives on suspicion of inflating earnings.
According to Biography.com, years later she admitted that the diagnosis left her unfocused and contributed to her exit from Mattel.
In 1978 she was indicted on charges of fraud and false reporting, and she later pleaded no contest.
She was sentenced to community service, but the sources give different numbers of hours.
Kveller describes her as a feminist icon, and also as someone who unwittingly reinforced patriarchal beauty standards.
Global News notes that her bold tactics sometimes raised eyebrows.

claims.text: ב-1970, בזמן שכיהנה כמנכ"לית מאטל, אובחנה הנדלר כחולה בסרטן שד.
claims.quote: In 1970, while still working as chief executive officer at Mattel, Handler had a brush with breast cancer.

claims.text: הנדלר נולדה בדנוור ב-1916 והיא ידועה בעיקר ביצירת ברבי.
claims.quote: Born in Denver in 1916, Ruth Handler is most well-known for her creation of the Barbie doll

claims.text: הנדלר התנסתה בפלסטיק ובסיליקון ועבדה עם מומחה לתותבים כדי ליצור פתרון טוב יותר לשורדות סרטן שד.
claims.quote: Handler experimented with plastic and silicone and worked with a prosthetics specialist to create a better solution for breast cancer survivors.

claims.text: תותב Nearly Me היה צורה מסיליקון נוזלי ופלסטיק שהיה זמין במגוון רחב של מידות.
claims.quote: a liquid silicone and plastic form available in a wide range of sizes

claims.text: התותב עלה בין 98 ל-130 דולר והיה זמין בגרסאות לצד שמאל ולצד ימין.
claims.quote: Handler’s prosthetic cost between $98 to $130 and came in versions for both the left and right sides of the body

claims.text: עד 1980 חברת Ruthton Corporation של הנדלר חגגה מכירות של מיליוני דולרים.
claims.quote: By 1980, Handler's company, Ruthton Corporation, was celebrating millions of dollars in sales.

claims.text: הנדלר מתה ב-2002, אך Nearly Me ממשיכה לייצר תותבי שד.
claims.quote: Handler passed away in 2002, but Nearly Me continues to make breast prostheses.

claims.text: לפי Biography.com, הנדלר הקימה את Ruthton Corp. ב-1976 ויצרה את התותב Nearly Me בהשראת תהליך ההחלמה שלה.
claims.quote: She founded Ruthton Corp. in 1976 and, inspired by her own cancer recovery process, created and manufactured the Nearly Me prosthetic breast

claims.text: לפי ספריית שלזינגר של הרווארד, הנדלר הקימה ב-1976 חברה עם ג'רלד פייטון כדי לשווק את Nearly Me.
claims.quote: she created her own, called Nearly Me, and formed a company in 1976 with Gerald Peyton to market it.

claims.text: לפי Kveller, ב-1970 אובחנה הנדלר ועברה כריתת שד חלקית.
claims.quote: In 1970, while still working at Mattel, Handler was first diagnosed with breast cancer and had a partial mastectomy.

claims.text: לפי MediaBurn, הנדלר עברה כריתת שד רדיקלית.
claims.quote: In 1970, Handler was diagnosed with breast cancer, and underwent a radical mastectomy.

claims.text: לפי היסטורי.קום, הנדלר עברה כריתה בה הוסר שדה השמאלי.
claims.quote: She underwent a mastectomy the same year, removing her left breast.

claims.text: רופא אחד יעץ להנדלר למלא את החזייה בגרבי ניילון ישנים, רעיון שהחריד אותה.
claims.quote: One doctor told her to stuff her bra with old nylon stockings—a notion that absolutely repulsed her.

claims.text: שורדת סרטן שד טיפוסית הסתמכה אז על מילוי מצמר גפן או על חזיות מרופדות.
claims.quote: The typical breast cancer survivor relied on cotton stuffing or padded bras to fit into old clothes or help reclaim a sense of self.

claims.text: באותה תקופה היו מעט מאוד חלופות לא-ניתוחיות לשחזור שד.
claims.quote: At the time, however, there were very few options for non-surgical alternatives to breast reconstruction.

claims.text: התותבים המלאכותיים שימשו לסירוגין לצד ימין או שמאל, ולכן כמעט לא ניתן היה להגיע למראה טבעי.
claims.quote: These artificial breasts, too, were used interchangeably for the right or left side, making it pretty much impossible to achieve a natural looking chest.

claims.text: הנדלר אמרה שהתותבים הקיימים תוכננו על ידי גברים שלא היה עליהם ללבוש אותם.
claims.quote: They were designed by men who obviously didn’t have to wear the damn thing.

claims.text: לפי סוזן שפירו, אחרי הכריתה הנדלר הייתה מדוכאת מאוד והרגישה שאיבדה חלק מזהותה.
claims.quote: So when she had the mastectomy, she was extremely depressed. She felt like she lost part of her identity.

claims.text: הנדלר אמרה ל-CBS ב-1994 שכשאיבדה את השד הרגישה כאילו איבדה את נשיותה.
claims.quote: I had been fighting to be a respected female executive all my life, and when I lost my breast it was as if I had lost my femininity,

claims.text: לפי Global News, הנדלר יצרה את צורת השד הראשונה בעולם מסיליקון נוזלי, שנועדה להיכנס לחזייה ולא מתחת לעור.
claims.quote: she set out to create the world’s first liquid silicone breast form that was meant to fit into a bra, rather than under the skin.

claims.text: הנדלר אמרה ל-New York Times ב-1977 שאין סנדלר שמייצר נעל אחת ומכריח לנעול בה גם רגל ימין וגם שמאל.
claims.quote: There has never been a shoemaker who made one shoe and forced you to put both your right and your left foot in it,

claims.text: לפי MediaBurn, הנדלר שיתפה פעולה עם פייטון מאסי כדי להשיק קו תותבים משלה.
claims.quote: She partnered with Peyton Massey to launch her own line of prosthesis

claims.text: סיסמת החברה הייתה שהשד המלאכותי הטוב ביותר נעשה על ידי אישה.
claims.quote: The best man-made breast are made by a woman.

claims.text: הנדלר הופיעה בחנויות כלבו והזמינה מארחי תוכניות לילה לגעת בשד התותב כהוכחה לתחושה האמיתית.
claims.quote: appearaing at department stores and inviting late-night hosts to cup her prosthetic breast as proof of the true-to-life feel.

claims.text: הנדלר איפשרה לעיתונאים ולנשים אחרות לגעת בתותבים ולחוש את המרקם הדומה למציאות.
claims.quote: She even allowed journalists and other women to touch them and feel their lifelike texture.

claims.text: לפי ארכיון הנשים היהודיות, הנדלר אתגרה עיתונאים לגעת בשדיה ולנחש איזה מהם אמיתי.
claims.quote: a breast prosthesis that felt so natural she challenged reporters to feel her breasts and tell her which one was real.

claims.text: הנדלר הופיעה בתוכניות אירוח וכתבה הזמנות בכתב יד לשיווק המוצר, וצוות המכירות שלה הכשיר עובדי חנויות כלבו להתאים תותבים.
claims.quote: She made talk show appearances and crafted handwritten invitations to market the product, and her sales team trained department store workers to fit patients for the prosthetic.

claims.text: הנדלר העסיקה נשים שעברו כריתת שד כדי לייעץ ללקוחות פוטנציאליות ולהתאים להן את התותב.
claims.quote: She employed women who also had mastectomies to best advise potential customers and fit them accordingly.

claims.text: הנדלר התאימה תותב Nearly Me מותאם אישית לבטי פורד, הגברת הראשונה לשעבר.
claims.quote: She even fitted former first lady Betty Ford—who publicly underwent a mastectomy in 1974—with her own custom-made Nearly Me.

claims.text: Nearly Me הגיע בזמן שבו התנועה הפמיניסטית לבריאות שינתה את השיח על נשים ושרידות מסרטן.
claims.quote: Nearly Me arrived at a time when the feminist health movement was transforming discussions about women and cancer survivorship

claims.text: תוך חמש שנים מיצירת Nearly Me חצו המכירות מיליון דולר אמריקני.
claims.quote: Within five years of creating the Nearly Me breast prosthesis, sales of the forms had surpassed US$1 million.

claims.text: לפי Kveller, החברה של הנדלר עזרה לאלפי נשים.
claims.quote: Her company helped thousands of women.

claims.text: הנדלר ניהלה את Ruthton עד 1991 ואז מכרה אותה לענקית המוצרים Kimberly-Clark.
claims.quote: Handler ran Ruthton Corporation until 1991, when she sold it to consumer products giant Kimberly-Clark.

claims.text: גם אחרי מכירת החברה ב-1991 המשיכה הנדלר להסביר לנשים על חשיבות הבדיקות לגילוי מוקדם של סרטן שד.
claims.quote: Even after selling the company in 1991, Handler continued to educate women about the importance of screenings for early detection of breast cancer.

claims.text: הנדלר אמרה שהעסק החדש לא הרוויח לה הרבה כסף, אך בנה מחדש את הערך העצמי שלה ולדעתה גם של אחרות.
claims.quote: It sure rebuilt my self-esteem, and I think I rebuilt the self-esteem of others.

claims.text: לפי Kveller, הנדלר אמרה שהיא רואה חשוב עוד יותר להחזיר את הערך העצמי לנשים שאיבדו אותו.
claims.quote: Now I find it even more important to return that self-esteem to women who have lost theirs.

claims.text: לפי SurvivorNet, קו המוצרים של Nearly Me קיים עד היום לצד מוצרים דומים כמו חזיות לאחר כריתה.
claims.quote: Fast forward nearly 50 years, and the product line still exists today alongside other similar products, such as mastectomy bras, to support women battling breast cancer.

claims.text: כותבת Global News, ששורדת סרטן שד בעצמה, מספרת שבבגדים מתאימים התותב שלה בלתי מורגש והסימטריה מדויקת.
claims.quote: In the right clothes, my prosthetic breast is undetectable. The symmetry is precise and the movement is natural.

claims.text: Kveller מתארת את רות הנדלר כממציאת ברבי היהודייה.
claims.quote: Ruth Handler, the Jewish inventor of Barbie, was watching her daughter Barbara one day.

claims.text: Kveller מתארת את הנדלר כיוצרת יהודייה של ברבי.
claims.quote: her Jewish creator, Ruth Mosko Handler, was not content to merely rest on the laurels of her archetype bombshell.

claims.text: הנדלר ובעלה סייעו להקים את בית הכנסת Temple Isaiah בלוס אנג'לס ותרמו למטרות יהודיות.
claims.quote: They helped found Temple Isaiah in Los Angeles. They gave to United Jewish Appeal and other Jewish causes.

claims.text: לפי Kveller, הנדלר הקימה את מאטל עם בעלה ב-1939.
claims.quote: Ruth was a businesswoman, who started the toy company Mattel with her husband in 1939.

claims.text: לפי Biography.com, מאטל נוסדה ב-1945 יחד עם המהנדס הרולד מאטסון.
claims.quote: the Handlers officially co-founded Mattel Creations in 1945 along with industrial engineer Harold Mattson

claims.text: לפי Kveller, הנדלר מתה מסרטן המעי הגס ב-2002.
claims.quote: Handler, who died of colon cancer in 2002, is played by another Jewish icon: Rhea Perlman.

claims.text: לפי SurvivorNet, הנדלר מתה ב-2002 בגיל 85 בעקבות סיבוכים בניתוח במעי הגס.
claims.quote: Handler died in 2002 at 85 following complications from colon surgery, the Los Angeles Times reported.

claims.text: לפי History Hit, הנדלר התפטרה ממאטל ב-1974 לאחר חקירות שהעלו דוחות כספיים מזויפים.
claims.quote: Following several investigations which yielded fraudulent financial reports, Ruth Handler resigned from Mattel in 1974.

claims.text: ב-1975, בזמן שרשות ניירות הערך חקרה את הנדלר ובכירים נוספים בחשד לניפוח רווחים, עזבה הנדלר את מאטל.
claims.quote: In 1975, while the Securities and Exchange Commission was investigating Handler and other executives for inflating earnings, Handler left Mattel.

claims.text: לפי Biography.com, הנדלר הודתה שנים אחר כך שהאבחנה גרמה לה לחוסר ריכוז ותרמה ליציאתה ממאטל.
claims.quote: she admitted years later the diagnosis left her unfocused and contributed to her exit from Mattel

claims.text: ב-1978 הוגש נגד הנדלר כתב אישום בעבירות הונאה ודיווח כוזב, ולאחר מכן לא חלקה על האישומים.
claims.quote: In 1978, she was indicted on charges of fraud and false reporting, to which she later pleaded no contest.

claims.text: לפי Kveller, הנדלר לא חלקה על האשמה ועונשה הומר ל-500 שעות שירות לציבור.
claims.quote: Ruth pled no contest, and her sentence was commuted into 500 hours of community service.

claims.text: לפי Biography.com, הנדלר נידונה ל-2,500 שעות שירות לציבור ולקנס של 57,000 דולר.
claims.quote: She was sentenced to 2,500 hours of community service and a $57,000 fine.

claims.text: Kveller מתארת את הנדלר כסמל פמיניסטי וגם כמי שחיזקה בלי כוונה סטנדרטים פטריארכליים של יופי.
claims.quote: She was both a feminist icon and a woman who unwittingly helped reinforce patriarchal beauty standards.

claims.text: Global News מציינת שהטקטיקות הנועזות של הנדלר העלו לעיתים גבות.
claims.quote: although her bold tactics would sometimes raise eyebrows

claims.text: לפי Global News, מאמר ב-New York Times מ-1995 ציטט את הנדלר על חשיבות הערך העצמי של נשים.
claims.quote: a 1995 New York Times article quoted Handler.

claims.text: לפי ארכיון הנשים היהודיות, הנדלר הסבירה לעיתונאי בתחילת שנות ה-80 את הקשר בין ברבי ל-Nearly Me.
claims.quote: She explained to a reporter in the early 1980s

claims.text: לפי Kveller, בשנה הראשונה נמכרו כ-350,000 בובות ברבי.
claims.quote: helped sell around 350,000 Barbie dolls in her first year of production

claims.text: לפי Biography.com, בשנה הראשונה נמכרו 300,000 בובות ברבי.
claims.quote: Barbie quickly became popular, with 300,000 dolls sold in just the first year of production

claims.text: לפי Biography.com, הנדלר כיהנה כנשיאת מאטל עד התפטרותה ב-1973.
claims.quote: Handler served as Mattel president until her resignation in 1973.

claims.text: היא עברה כריתת שד, אבל המקורות מתארים אותה בדרכים שונות.
claims.quote: She underwent a mastectomy the same year, removing her left breast.

claims.text: דרך החברה הזאת ייצרה גרסה מציאותית יותר של שד אישה.
claims.quote: I think we can agree a plastic breast imitates the feel more than a bunch of cotton you'd buy at Joann Fabrics.

claims.text: הנדלר עזבה את מאטל על רקע חקירות בעניין הדוחות הכספיים של החברה.
claims.quote: An SEC investigation held the Handlers responsible and they were forced out of the company in 1975.

claims.text: התפטרה ב-1975
claims.quote: 1975: Resigned as president of Mattel.
